image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a rabbit's head and upper shoulders. The subject features dense, textured fur in shades of brown, grey, and black (agouti pattern). One large, dark eye is clearly visible with a realistic reflection. The nose area shows fine whiskers and a split upper lip structure. The ears are partially visible at the top, showing pink inner skin and fur. The background is blurred natural vegetation.
